format: Witness batch plan v1; all IDs zero-based; context order is the pinned payload order

history_jobs.required_equation: boxWitnessValid history direction box (.history ruleIndex) = true
boxWitnessValid history direction box (.history ruleIndex) = true
boxWitnessValid history direction box (.history ruleIndex) = true

semantics.base: At history zero, check entriesHistoryFree and entriesValid on the unchanged class-position slice zipped with the listed witness IDs.
semantics.transport: Use entries_valid_transport with the same direction and target history less than 75.
semantics.history: Check the original head separately at its actual history, then use base_after_history_valid. Preserve position zero; do not append.
semantics.zip: Reconstructed full ordered geometry/witness pairs exactly equal every original context zip; both lengths are equal.
semantics.minimality: 507 is the exact number of distinct direction-and-ordered-base-entry lists under whole-list sharing and history transport. No optimality over alternative proofs or per-entry sharing is asserted.
semantics.direction: Identical witness-list data at different directions does not transfer validity; each direction remains a separate job.

scope: Deterministic planning and exact alignment audit only. No new validity equation, numeric membership theorem or global bound has been checked.
